scope: Research scientists and early-career research faculty in quantitative public health, statistics and environmental modeling. This is a small purposive comparison, not a ranking or evidence of hiring/citation outcomes.

guidance.use: Audience-first organization, shallow navigation, recognizable labels, short biography and easy CV/contact access. The suggested menu count is design advice, not an accessibility requirement.
Informative titles, meaningful links, headings, clear language and text alternatives.
Named navigation regions, logical headings and direct access to main content.
Explain scientific plots in surrounding text and make essential information available beyond the image; retain accessible tables and downloads.

edits_in_this_pr: Six primary destinations: About, Publications, Research & software, CV, Teaching, Talks. Keep existing URLs.
Move modeling applications, computed examples, figure downloads, repositories and outside-work photos into labelled footer navigation; keep contextual links on the homepage and project pages.
Collapse the primary menu below the large Bootstrap breakpoint to avoid the crowded intermediate-width layout observed in the existing site.
Use the current Assistant Scientist appointment in the subtitle and visible email/ORCID links from existing shared data.
Remove repeated institution text below the portrait; retain the location and full affiliation in the introduction.
Add short descriptions beside three selected public papers, grounded in their titles/abstracts; retain verified full citation metadata.
Add a keyboard skip link and an identifiable focusable main landmark.
Keep real publication section/paper/skip anchors distinct from legacy text-search fragments; fix filter debounce and cover the fragment contract in CI.

further_recommendations.recommendation: Develop a short Research overview organized around scientific questions, with links from each topic to public papers, computational examples and relevant software. If this grows beyond the present combined page, split Research and Software into distinct destinations.
further_recommendations.reason: The project catalogue currently leads with packages; readers from public health or another discipline may need a clearer account of the research programme.
further_recommendations.constraint: Keep structural-score and other private work at the level of questions and evaluation goals; avoid unpublished mechanisms, results, acceptance claims or unsupported priority claims.

further_recommendations.recommendation: Check reading order, link annotations and text alternatives in the generated CV PDF using an assistive-technology workflow, and check captions/transcripts for teaching and talk videos.
further_recommendations.reason: The current CV is tagged and HTML alternatives exist, but those facts alone do not establish accessible reading order or document conformance.
further_recommendations.constraint: Do not claim WCAG/PDF-UA conformance from these browser checks.

further_recommendations.recommendation: When a public research result is available, add a concise question/result/artifact narrative rather than expanding the number of diagrams or raw repository cards.
further_recommendations.reason: The computed figures already show concrete scientific work. More visuals should explain a result or comparison, with captions and accessible data.

further_recommendations.recommendation: Review appointment, manuscript status, grant roles and package availability after material changes, with periodic editorial review. Keep the existing automated artifact/link/publication checks.
further_recommendations.reason: Accurate status is more useful than an unmaintained news feed.
further_recommendations.constraint: Do not add lab/group/recruiting language unless it reflects the actual role and current opportunities.

validation_limits: Browser layout and keyboard checks are scoped checks, not a complete accessibility audit. No analytics or user-study evidence was used. Recommendations are editorial judgments informed by the cited primary pages and guidance.

phrasing_alignment.scope: Homepage, project summaries, package descriptions, CV research-software summaries, computed examples and the constructed constraint-check illustration.
decisions: Lead research summaries with questions that readers outside the specialty can understand; expand standalone-page acronyms.
Describe outcome-independent checks without implying exclusion of observations available when a prediction is issued.
Distinguish observed constraint compliance, satisfaction by construction, predictive accuracy and application adequacy.
Keep identification and calibration claims conditional on the model, observations and assessed property.
Use public summaries of ongoing work without disclosing private methods, results or submission plans.
Retain spatial, nonlocal, compartmental and stochastic scope for OP System and OP Engine.
Use descriptive second-level headings on the research-in-progress page and preserve existing fragment URLs.
Keep the constructed illustration scoped to the displayed horizon and publish matching captions, text alternatives, sources and exports.

research_framing.decision: Lead with scientific questions, mathematical modeling, statistical methods and applications. Discuss observation limits where they affect a particular inference or study-design problem.

terminology.partially_observed: A technical description relative to a model state and measurement process; not a claim that incomplete observation distinguishes an entire research programme.
terminology.structured: Name the relevant organization, such as age, space, traits or groups.
terminology.complex: Use for interactions and collective behavior when those are the subject, rather than as a default substitute for partially observed.

sources.supports: Established partially observed Markov process, hidden Markov and state-space modeling terminology.
Complexity research concerns interacting components and emerging system-wide behavior.
Structured population models explicitly represent age, size, traits, spatial position or related heterogeneity.

research_framing.scope: Homepage, site/search metadata, project overview, research introduction, CV profile and observation-model diagram. Retain specific incomplete-data and scientific-constraint research descriptions and original publication/talk titles.
